children: Hitachi Energy India shares rose up to 3 percent on Thursday after global brokerage Jefferies gave a 'Buy' rating on the stock and set a price target of Rs 45,790, implying an upside of about 52 percent from the previous close.
The stock hit a high of Rs 31,050 per share on the NSE, up 3 percent.
In its note, Jefferies said the management was confident that spending on power transmission and distribution (T&D) would remain a multi-year growth story in India.
The brokerage said the company's renewed focus on increasing the share of services in revenues should add to growth ahead.
Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and data centres were also highlighted as major opportunities in India, Jefferies said.
The brokerage expects a 54 percent compound annual growth rate (CAGR) in earnings per share (EPS) during FY26-29E, which it said should drive the upside in the stock.
